name: Hotel Las Islas Baru
insider_take: This Caribbean paradise sits on pristine Barú Island, where crystal-clear waters meet powdery white sand just 45 minutes from Cartagena's historic walled city.
whats_special: Hotel Las Islas Baru is located on the stunning Playa Blanca, consistently ranked among Colombia's most beautiful beaches. The property offers exclusive access to this tropical haven where the Rosario Islands' coral reefs create some of the Caribbean's best snorkeling and diving spots. As a Leading Hotels of the World member, it combines barefoot luxury with authentic Colombian coastal culture.
pro_tip: Book the hotel's private boat transfer from Cartagena - it's not only the most scenic route but also lets you spot dolphins and enjoy champagne service while cruising through the Rosario Islands archipelago.
dont_miss: Take a sunset catamaran to the nearby Isla del Encanto to see the bioluminescent plankton light up the water at night, and visit the National Natural Park Corales del Rosario for world-class diving among vibrant coral formations that are home to over 170 fish species.
pros: Exclusive private island location with pristine beaches
Exceptional water sports and diving opportunities
cons: Remote island location requires boat transfer
Limited dining options due to secluded setting
